bibl.title: Naukratis in Context: programme and bibliography.
bibl.seg: Aurélia Masson-Berghoff & Ross Thomas, Naukratis in Context: programme and bibliography.
British Museum Studies in Ancient Egypt and Sudan 24 (2019) pp. 1-6.
bibl.note: Special issue of British Museum Studies in Ancient Egypt and Sudan publishing papers and additional reflections arising from two workshops organised at the British Museum in 2011 and 2013 as part of the British Museum's Naukratis Project. The first workshop ("The Nile Delta as a landscape of connectivity") was organised by R.Th. and the second workshop ("Religious Naukratis in context") by Marianne Bergeron & A.M.-B.
